3.pattern: Menurut saya ___ karena ___. Kamu sendiri bagaimana?
3.meaningKo: 의견을 말하고, 이유를 설명한 후 상대방에게 묻기
3.meaningEn: Giving your opinion with a reason, and asking for theirs

examples.text: Menurut saya film itu seru karena ceritanya menarik. Kamu sendiri bagaimana?
examples.ko: 내 생각엔 그 영화가 재밌어, 줄거리가 흥미로워서. 너는 어때?
examples.en: I think the movie is fun because the story is interesting. How about you?

examples.text: Menurut saya hotel ini nyaman karena pelayanannya ramah. Kamu sendiri bagaimana?
examples.ko: 내 생각엔 이 호텔이 편안해, 서비스가 친절해서. 너는 어때?
examples.en: I think this hotel is comfortable because the service is friendly. How about you?

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 빈칸에 의견, 두 번째 빈칸에 이유
grammar.noteEn: First blank is opinion, second is reason

quiz.prompt: Menurut saya restoran ini enak karena ___ . Kamu sendiri bagaimana?

3.pattern: Maaf, saya memesan ___, tapi saya dapat ___. Bisa bantu perbaiki?
3.meaningKo: 예약이나 주문에 문제를 설명하고 수정 요청하기
3.meaningEn: Explaining a booking or order problem and requesting a fix

examples.text: Maaf, saya memesan kamar deluxe, tapi saya dapat kamar standar. Bisa bantu perbaiki?
examples.ko: 죄송하지만 디럭스룸을 예약했는데 스탠다드룸을 받았어요. 도와주실 수 있나요?
examples.en: Sorry, I booked a deluxe room, but I got a standard room. Can you help fix this?

examples.text: Maaf, saya memesan ayam goreng, tapi saya dapat ikan. Bisa bantu perbaiki?
examples.ko: 죄송하지만 치킨을 주문했는데 생선을 받았어요. 고쳐주실 수 있나요?
examples.en: Sorry, I ordered fried chicken, but I got fish. Can you help fix it?

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 빈칸에 원래 주문/예약한 것, 두 번째 빈칸에 받은 것
grammar.noteEn: First blank is what was ordered, second what was received

quiz.prompt: Maaf, saya memesan kopi, tapi saya dapat ___. Bisa bantu perbaiki?

3.pattern: Sekarang saya bekerja di ___ sebagai ___. Tugas saya biasanya ___
3.meaningEn: Describing your workplace, role, and main duties

examples.text: Sekarang saya bekerja di kantor pusat sebagai admin. Tugas saya biasanya mengatur jadwal rapat
examples.ko: 지금 본사에서 관리자 역할을 하고 있어. 내 업무는 주로 회의 일정을 조정하는 거야
examples.en: Now I work at the head office as an admin. My job is usually to arrange meeting schedules

examples.text: Sekarang saya bekerja di sekolah sebagai guru. Tugas saya biasanya mengajar matematika
examples.ko: 지금 학교에서 선생님으로 일해. 내 업무는 주로 수학을 가르치는 거야
examples.en: Now I work at a school as a teacher. My main duty is teaching math

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 빈칸에 직장명, 두 번째 빈칸에 직책, 세 번째 빈칸에 주된 업무
grammar.noteEn: First blank is workplace, second is position, third is main duty

related: Saya kuliah di ___ jurusan ___, dan biasanya ___

quiz.prompt: Sekarang saya bekerja di rumah sakit sebagai ___. Tugas saya biasanya memeriksa pasien

3.pattern: Kalau dengan teman, saya biasanya bilang ___. Kalau dengan orang baru, saya bilang ___
3.meaningKo: 친구와 처음 만난 사람에게 각각 다르게 말하는 표현 설명
3.meaningEn: Explaining how you speak differently with friends vs. strangers

examples.text: Kalau dengan teman, saya biasanya bilang 'lu'. Kalau dengan orang baru, saya bilang 'Anda'.
examples.ko: 친구한테는 'lu'라고 하고, 처음 만난 사람한테는 'Anda'라고 해
examples.en: With friends, I usually say 'lu'. With new people, I say 'Anda'.

examples.text: Kalau dengan teman, saya biasanya bilang 'halo bro'. Kalau dengan orang baru, saya bilang 'selamat pagi'.
examples.ko: 친구한테는 'halo bro'라고 하고, 생소한 사람에게는 'selamat pagi'라고 해
examples.en: With friends, I usually say 'halo bro'. With new people, I say 'selamat pagi'.

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 빈칸에 친구에게 쓰는 표현, 두 번째 빈칸에 낯선 사람에게 쓰는 표현
grammar.noteEn: First blank is for friends, second for strangers

related: Kalau sama orang tua, saya bilang ___

quiz.prompt: Kalau dengan teman, saya biasanya bilang 'kamu'. Kalau dengan orang baru, saya bilang ___

3.meaningKo: 특정 장소에서 한 일을 순서대로 말하기
3.meaningEn: Telling a sequence of actions at a place

examples.text: Waktu di Lombok, saya sempat snorkeling lalu makan seafood
examples.ko: 롬복에 있을 때 스노클링도 하고 해산물도 먹었어
examples.en: When I was in Lombok, I went snorkeling and then ate seafood

examples.text: Waktu di hotel, saya sempat berenang lalu tidur siang
examples.ko: 호텔에 있을 때 수영도 하고 낮잠도 잤어
examples.en: When I was at the hotel, I went swimming and then took a nap

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 빈칸에 장소, 두 번째와 세 번째 빈칸에 했던 일
grammar.noteEn: First blank is place, second and third are actions

quiz.prompt: Waktu di pantai, saya sempat berenang lalu ___

3.pattern: Saya suka ___ karena ___. Kamu juga suka?
3.meaningKo: 취향을 이유와 함께 밝히고, 상대에게도 물어보기
3.meaningEn: Stating what you like with a reason, and asking if the other does too

examples.text: Saya suka menonton drama Korea karena ceritanya seru. Kamu juga suka?
examples.ko: 나는 한국 드라마를 좋아해, 스토리가 재밌어서. 너도 좋아해?
examples.en: I like watching Korean dramas because the story is fun. Do you like them too?

examples.text: Saya suka kopi karena aromanya wangi. Kamu juga suka?
examples.ko: 나는 커피를 좋아해, 향이 좋아서. 너도 좋아해?
examples.en: I like coffee because it smells good. Do you like it too?

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 빈칸에 좋아하는 것, 두 번째 빈칸에 이유
grammar.noteEn: First blank is what you like, second is the reason

quiz.prompt: Saya suka membaca buku karena ___. Kamu juga suka?

3.meaningKo: 현재 하고 있는 일 때문에 아직 못하는 일 설명하기
3.meaningEn: Explaining what you're doing so you can't do something else yet

examples.text: Saya sedang meeting, jadi saya belum bisa angkat telepon
examples.ko: 지금 회의 중이라 아직 전화를 받을 수 없어
examples.en: I'm in a meeting, so I can't pick up the phone yet

examples.text: Saya sedang belajar, jadi saya belum bisa keluar
examples.ko: 지금 공부 중이라 아직 나갈 수 없어
examples.en: I'm studying, so I can't go out yet

grammar.nameKo: 진행 중인 일 + 아직 할 수 없는 일
grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 빈칸에 현재 하는 일, 두 번째 빈칸에 할 수 없는 일
grammar.noteEn: First blank is current activity, second is what can't be done

quiz.prompt: Saya sedang makan siang, jadi saya belum bisa ___

3.pattern: Pertama saya ___, lalu saya ___, setelah itu saya ___.
3.meaningEn: Telling a story about a trip or event in order

examples.text: Pertama saya naik perahu, lalu saya snorkeling, setelah itu saya makan ikan bakar.
examples.ko: 처음에 배를 타고, 그 다음 스노클링을 하고, 마지막으로 구운 생선을 먹었어.
examples.en: First I took a boat, then I went snorkeling, after that I ate grilled fish.

examples.text: Pertama saya check-in di hotel, lalu saya jalan-jalan di pantai, setelah itu saya istirahat di kamar.
examples.ko: 처음에 호텔에 체크인하고, 그 다음 해변을 산책하고, 마지막으로 방에서 쉬었어.
examples.en: First I checked in at the hotel, then I walked on the beach, after that I rested in my room.

grammar.noteEn: Each ___ is for an activity or event in order

quiz.prompt: Pertama saya ___, lalu saya makan, setelah itu saya tidur.

3.pattern: Kalau menurut saya, ___ karena ___. Bagaimana menurutmu?
3.meaningKo: 의견과 이유를 말하고 상대방 의견 묻기
3.meaningEn: Giving an opinion and a reason, and asking for someone's opinion

examples.text: Kalau menurut saya, film ini bagus karena ceritanya unik. Bagaimana menurutmu?
examples.ko: 내 생각엔 이 영화가 좋아, 이야기가 독특해서. 너는 어때?
examples.en: In my opinion, this movie is good because the story is unique. What do you think?

examples.text: Kalau menurut saya, pantai di Lombok indah karena pasirnya putih. Bagaimana menurutmu?
examples.ko: 내 생각엔 롬복의 해변이 아름다워, 모래가 하얘서. 너는 어때?
examples.en: In my opinion, the beach in Lombok is beautiful because the sand is white. What do you think?

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 ___에 의견, 두 번째 ___에 이유
grammar.noteEn: First ___ is the opinion, second ___ is the reason

quiz.prompt: Kalau menurut saya, makanan ini enak karena ___. Bagaimana menurutmu?

3.pattern: Maaf, saya pesan ___, tapi yang datang ___. Bisa dibantu?
3.meaningKo: 예약, 배달, 상품 문제 설명하고 해결 요청하기
3.meaningEn: Explaining a booking, delivery or product problem and asking for a fix

examples.text: Maaf, saya pesan kamar deluxe, tapi yang datang kamar standar. Bisa dibantu?
examples.ko: 죄송하지만 디럭스룸을 예약했는데 스탠다드룸이 왔어요. 도와주실 수 있나요?
examples.en: Sorry, I booked a deluxe room, but what I got is a standard room. Can you help?

examples.text: Maaf, saya pesan makanan tanpa pedas, tapi yang datang pedas. Bisa dibantu?
examples.ko: 죄송하지만 매운맛 없이 주문했는데 매운 게 왔어요. 도와주실 수 있나요?
examples.en: Sorry, I ordered non-spicy food, but what I got is spicy. Can you help?

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 ___: 원래 주문/예약한 것, 두 번째 ___: 실제 받은 것
grammar.noteEn: First ___: what you ordered/booked, second ___: what you got

related: Saya memesan ___, tapi saya menerima ___. Bisa bantu?
Mohon maaf, saya sudah bayar ___, tapi belum datang.

quiz.prompt: Maaf, saya pesan ayam goreng, tapi yang datang ___. Bisa dibantu?

4.pattern: Saya paham kekhawatiran Anda tentang ___, tapi menurut saya ___ bisa menjadi solusi.
4.meaningEn: Acknowledging concerns and suggesting a solution

examples.text: Saya paham kekhawatiran Anda tentang jadwal, tapi menurut saya penjadwalan ulang bisa menjadi solusi.
examples.ko: 일정에 대한 우려를 이해하지만, 일정을 다시 잡는 것이 해결책이 될 수 있다고 생각합니다.
examples.en: I understand your concern about the schedule, but I think rescheduling could be a solution.

examples.text: Saya paham kekhawatiran Anda tentang biaya, tapi menurut saya negosiasi harga bisa menjadi solusi.
examples.ko: 비용에 대한 우려를 이해하지만, 가격 협상이 해결책이 될 수 있다고 생각합니다.
examples.en: I understand your concern about the cost, but I think negotiating the price could be a solution.

grammar.noteKo: 첫 슬롯에는 상대방의 걱정이나 이슈가 들어갑니다.
grammar.noteEn: First slot is the concern or issue.

grammar.noteKo: 두 번째 슬롯에는 제안하는 해결책이 들어갑니다.
grammar.noteEn: Second slot is the proposed solution.

quiz.prompt: Saya paham kekhawatiran Anda tentang ___, tapi menurut saya negosiasi bisa menjadi solusi.

4.pattern: Saya mengerti kekhawatiran Anda tentang ___, tapi jika kita ___, mungkin bisa jadi solusi.
4.meaningEn: Acknowledging concerns and proposing an alternative

examples.text: Saya mengerti kekhawatiran Anda tentang jadwal, tapi jika kita tambah tim, mungkin bisa jadi solusi.
examples.ko: 일정에 대한 걱정을 이해하지만, 팀을 늘리면 해결될 수 있어요.
examples.en: I understand your concern about the schedule, but adding more people could be a solution.

examples.text: Saya mengerti kekhawatiran Anda tentang biaya, tapi jika kita negosiasi ulang, mungkin bisa jadi solusi.
examples.ko: 비용에 대한 걱정을 이해하지만, 재협상하면 해결될 수 있어요.
examples.en: I understand your concern about the cost, but renegotiating could be a solution.

grammar.noteEn: The first blank is a concern or issue
The second blank is the proposed action

quiz.prompt: Saya mengerti kekhawatiran Anda tentang ___, tapi jika kita tambah tim, mungkin bisa jadi solusi.

4.pattern: Saya paham alasan ___, tapi menurut saya lebih baik jika ___.
4.meaningKo: 상대방 입장 존중하며 다른 의견 제시하기
4.meaningEn: Disagreeing tactfully while respecting the other side

examples.text: Saya paham alasan mempercepat proyek, tapi menurut saya lebih baik jika kita cek ulang dulu.
examples.ko: 프로젝트를 빨리 끝내고 싶은 이유는 알지만, 먼저 다시 확인하는 게 좋을 것 같아요.
examples.en: I understand the reason to speed up the project, but I think it's better if we double-check first.

examples.text: Saya paham alasan memilih lokasi ini, tapi menurut saya lebih baik jika kita survei tempat lain juga.
examples.ko: 이 장소를 고른 이유는 알지만, 다른 곳도 조사해보는 게 좋을 것 같아요.
examples.en: I understand the reason for choosing this location, but I think it's better if we also survey other places.

grammar.noteEn: The first blank is the reason for the other's action
The second blank is your suggestion

related: Saya mengerti kekhawatiran Anda tentang ___, tapi jika kita ___, mungkin bisa jadi solusi.

quiz.prompt: Saya paham alasan mempercepat proyek, tapi menurut saya lebih baik jika kita ___.

4.pattern: Setelah mendengar pendapat ___, saya ringkas poin utama: ___.
4.meaningEn: Summarizing main points in a meeting or discussion

examples.text: Setelah mendengar pendapat semua, saya ringkas poin utama: kita sepakat tunda peluncuran.
examples.ko: 모두의 의견을 듣고 주요 내용을 정리하자면, 출시를 연기하기로 합의했습니다.
examples.en: After hearing everyone's opinions, I summarize the main point: we agree to postpone the launch.

examples.text: Setelah mendengar pendapat tim, saya ringkas poin utama: biaya harus ditekan.
examples.ko: 팀 의견을 듣고 요약하면, 비용을 줄여야 한다는 점입니다.
examples.en: After hearing the team's opinions, I summarize the main point: costs must be reduced.

grammar.noteEn: The first blank is whose opinion is being summarized
The second blank is the main point

quiz.prompt: Setelah mendengar pendapat tim, saya ringkas poin utama: ___.

examples.text: Tugas Andi adalah membuat laporan akhir.
examples.ko: Andi의 임무는 최종 보고서를 작성하는 것입니다.
examples.en: Andi's task is to write the final report.

examples.text: Tugas tim pemasaran adalah mengatur promosi.
examples.ko: 마케팅팀의 임무는 프로모션을 준비하는 것입니다.
examples.en: The marketing team's task is to arrange the promotion.

grammar.noteEn: The first blank is the person or team assigned
The second blank is the task

related: Setelah mendengar pendapat ___, saya ringkas poin utama: ___.

quiz.prompt: Tugas tim pemasaran adalah ___.

4.pattern: Kalau boleh tahu, apakah ___ bisa dinegosiasikan menjadi ___?
4.meaningEn: Requesting negotiation about terms or price politely

examples.text: Kalau boleh tahu, apakah harga sewa bisa dinegosiasikan menjadi lebih rendah?
examples.ko: 실례지만, 임대료를 더 낮게 협상할 수 있을까요?
examples.en: If I may ask, can the rent be negotiated to a lower price?

examples.text: Kalau boleh tahu, apakah tanggal jatuh tempo bisa dinegosiasikan menjadi minggu depan?
examples.ko: 실례지만, 기한을 다음 주로 조정할 수 있을까요?
examples.en: If I may ask, can the deadline be negotiated to next week?

grammar.noteEn: The first blank is the term or price to negotiate
The second blank is the requested new term

related: Saya ingin konfirmasi apakah ___ bisa diubah menjadi ___?

quiz.prompt: Kalau boleh tahu, apakah harga sewa bisa dinegosiasikan menjadi ___?

4.meaningEn: Pointing out an issue or deficiency politely

examples.text: Menurut informasi, dokumen masih kurang tanda tangan.
examples.ko: 정보에 따르면, 서류에 아직 서명이 부족합니다.
examples.en: According to the information, the document still lacks a signature.

examples.text: Menurut informasi, laporan masih kurang data pendukung.
examples.ko: 정보에 따르면, 보고서에 아직 보조 자료가 부족합니다.
examples.en: According to the information, the report still lacks supporting data.

grammar.noteEn: The first blank is the item with a deficiency
The second blank is what is missing

related: Saya ingin konfirmasi apakah ___ sudah sesuai dengan ___.

quiz.prompt: Menurut informasi, dokumen masih kurang ___.

4.pattern: Saya paham pendapat Anda, tapi saya rasa ___ bisa dipertimbangkan juga.

examples.text: Saya paham pendapat Anda, tapi saya rasa alternatif ini bisa dipertimbangkan juga.
examples.ko: 당신의 의견을 이해하지만 이 대안도 고려할 만하다고 생각해요.
examples.en: I understand your opinion, but I think this alternative can also be considered.

examples.text: Saya paham pendapat Anda, tapi saya rasa jadwal baru bisa dipertimbangkan juga.
examples.ko: 당신의 의견을 이해하지만 새 일정도 고려할 수 있다고 생각해요.
examples.en: I understand your opinion, but I think the new schedule can also be considered.

grammar.noteEn: The blank is for the alternative or idea you want to propose.

quiz.prompt: Saya paham pendapat Anda, tapi saya rasa ___ bisa dipertimbangkan juga.

5.pattern: Bapak/Ibu ___, izinkan saya mengucapkan terima kasih atas ___

examples.text: Bapak/Ibu Andi, izinkan saya mengucapkan terima kasih atas bimbingan dan dukungannya
examples.ko: 안디 선생님, 지도와 지원에 진심으로 감사드립니다.
examples.en: Mr./Ms. Andi, allow me to thank you for your guidance and support.

examples.text: Bapak/Ibu Sari, izinkan saya mengucapkan terima kasih atas kesempatan yang diberikan
examples.ko: 사리 선생님, 기회를 주신 데 대해 감사드립니다.
examples.en: Ms. Sari, allow me to thank you for the opportunity you gave.

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 칸에는 상대방의 존칭이나 이름이 들어갑니다.
grammar.noteEn: The first slot is for the recipient's name or title.

related: Terima kasih atas ___ yang sudah diberikan
Saya ingin mengucapkan selamat kepada ___ atas ___

quiz.prompt: Bapak/Ibu ___, izinkan saya mengucapkan terima kasih atas bimbingan dan dukungannya

5.pattern: Mohon maaf, saat ini saya belum bisa ___ karena ___

examples.text: Mohon maaf, saat ini saya belum bisa memenuhi permintaan karena masih ada pekerjaan lain
examples.ko: 죄송하지만 지금은 다른 일이 있어서 요청을 들어드릴 수 없습니다.
examples.en: Sorry, I can't fulfill the request right now because I have other work.

examples.text: Mohon maaf, saat ini saya belum bisa hadir karena ada urusan keluarga
examples.ko: 가족 일이 있어서 참석할 수 없습니다.
examples.en: Sorry, I can't attend right now because of family matters.

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 칸은 거절하는 행동, 두 번째 칸은 이유.
grammar.noteEn: First slot is the action refused, second is the reason.

related: Untuk saat ini, saya belum bisa ___

quiz.prompt: Mohon maaf, saat ini saya belum bisa hadir karena ___

5.pattern: Eh, lo tau nggak, ___ kemarin itu ___ banget, sampe ___

examples.text: Eh, lo tau nggak, si Dika kemarin itu ngaco banget, sampe ketawa semua orang
examples.ko: 야, 어제 디카 진짜 엉망이었어, 모두가 웃었어.
examples.en: Hey, do you know, Dika was so ridiculous yesterday, everyone laughed.

examples.text: Eh, lo tau nggak, acara kemarin itu heboh banget, sampe tetangga pada protes
examples.ko: 어제 행사 진짜 난리였어, 이웃들이 항의했어.
examples.en: Hey, you know, yesterday's event was so wild, the neighbors complained.

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 칸은 이야기 주제, 두 번째 칸은 감탄사, 세 번째 칸은 결과.
grammar.noteEn: First slot: topic/person. Second: reaction. Third: result.

quiz.prompt: Eh, lo tau nggak, acara kemarin itu heboh banget, sampe ___

5.pattern: Saya ingin mengucapkan selamat jalan kepada ___, semoga ___
5.meaningKo: 공식적인 작별 인사와 좋은 소망 전하기
5.meaningEn: Offering formal farewell and well wishes

examples.text: Saya ingin mengucapkan selamat jalan kepada Pak Budi, semoga sukses di tempat baru
examples.ko: 부디 님께 작별 인사 드리며, 새로운 곳에서 성공하시길 바랍니다.
examples.en: I want to say farewell to Mr. Budi, wishing you success in your new place.

examples.text: Saya ingin mengucapkan selamat jalan kepada Ibu Lina, semoga sehat selalu
examples.ko: 리나 님께 작별 인사 드리며, 항상 건강하시길 바랍니다.
examples.en: I want to wish farewell to Ms. Lina, may you always be healthy.

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 칸은 떠나는 사람, 두 번째 칸은 바람.
grammar.noteEn: First slot: the person leaving. Second: your wish.

quiz.prompt: Saya ingin mengucapkan selamat jalan kepada Pak Budi, semoga ___

5.meaningKo: 소문이나 일반적 의견에 대해 개인 의견 제시하기
5.meaningEn: Presenting own opinion after a rumor or common belief

examples.text: Katanya sih film itu bagus, tapi menurut gue biasa aja
examples.ko: 그 영화 좋다고들 하지만, 내 생각엔 그냥 그래.
examples.en: They say the movie is good, but I think it's just okay.

examples.text: Katanya sih harga bakal turun, tapi menurut gue malah naik
examples.ko: 가격이 떨어질 거라고들 하지만, 내 생각엔 오를 것 같아.
examples.en: They say prices will drop, but I think they'll go up.

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 칸은 소문, 두 번째 칸은 본인 의견.
grammar.noteEn: First slot: rumor/common belief. Second: your view.

quiz.prompt: Katanya sih film itu bagus, tapi menurut gue ___

5.pattern: Kalau boleh jujur, saya merasa ___, tapi demi kebaikan bersama, ___

examples.text: Kalau boleh jujur, saya merasa kurang nyaman, tapi demi kebaikan bersama, saya akan berusaha menyesuaikan diri
examples.ko: 솔직히 좀 불편하지만, 모두를 위해서 적응하려고 합니다.
examples.en: Honestly, I feel a bit uncomfortable, but for the common good, I'll try to adjust.

examples.text: Kalau boleh jujur, saya merasa tugas ini berat, tapi demi kebaikan bersama, saya akan coba semaksimal mungkin
examples.ko: 이 일이 힘들지만 모두의 이익을 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다.
examples.en: Honestly, I feel this task is tough, but for everyone's good, I'll try my best.

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 칸은 솔직한 감정, 두 번째 칸은 배려하는 행동.
grammar.noteEn: First slot: honest feeling. Second: group-oriented action.

related: Terus terang, saya ___, tapi saya percaya ___

quiz.prompt: Kalau boleh jujur, saya merasa tugas ini berat, tapi demi kebaikan bersama, ___

5.pattern: Intinya, ___, tapi ada beberapa hal yang perlu diperhatikan seperti ___
5.meaningKo: 글, 강연 요약 및 비판적 언급하기
5.meaningEn: Summarizing and critiquing a text, talk or film

examples.text: Intinya, film ini menyenangkan, tapi ada beberapa hal yang perlu diperhatikan seperti alur cerita yang kurang jelas
examples.ko: 요약하면 이 영화는 재미있지만, 줄거리가 불분명한 점이 있어요.
examples.en: In summary, this movie is enjoyable, but there are things to note like the unclear plot.

examples.text: Intinya, artikelnya informatif, tapi ada beberapa hal yang perlu diperhatikan seperti kurangnya data pendukung
examples.ko: 요약하자면 정보는 좋지만, 근거 자료가 부족해요.
examples.en: In summary, the article is informative, but things like lack of supporting data should be noted.

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 칸은 요점, 두 번째 칸은 비판적 사항.
grammar.noteEn: First slot: key point. Second slot: points of critique.

related: Menurut saya, ___ adalah poin kuatnya, tapi ___ masih kurang

quiz.prompt: Intinya, film ini menyenangkan, tapi ada beberapa hal yang perlu diperhatikan seperti ___

5.pattern: Maaf, boleh saya menambahkan sedikit tentang ___ sebelum kita lanjut?

examples.text: Maaf, boleh saya menambahkan sedikit tentang topik kerja sama sebelum kita lanjut?
examples.ko: 협력 주제에 대해 잠깐 말씀드려도 될까요?
examples.en: Sorry, may I add a bit about the cooperation topic before we continue?

examples.text: Maaf, boleh saya menambahkan sedikit tentang acara kemarin sebelum kita lanjut?
examples.ko: 어제 행사에 대해 잠깐만 덧붙여도 될까요?
examples.en: Sorry, can I add a little about yesterday's event before we move on?

grammar.noteKo: 첫 번째 칸은 추가하고 싶은 주제.
grammar.noteEn: First slot: topic you want to add about.

quiz.prompt: Maaf, boleh saya menambahkan sedikit tentang ___ sebelum kita lanjut?
